subject: HelixHealth - EU-exclusive processing: operational questions and evidence requests
messages:
From: Andrew Bates <andrew.bates@helixhealth.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: privacy@helixhealth.com
Date: 2028-06-14T08:23:00Z
Subject: EU-only routing confirmation + SCCs questions

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of our procurement and internal privacy review we need to confirm several operational guarantees before progressing:

- Can Redwood guarantee that HelixHealth customer data & inference traffic will be processed exclusively within EU regions (no cross-border processing) for production workloads?
- What is the behavior for backups/snapshots and disaster recovery — are snapshots stored outside EU?
- Who can decrypt data or access plaintext (support/admin roles)? Any possibility of US-based staff access?
- We need evidence for SCCs: statements about routing, KMS regions, deletion proofs, and logs showing no export.
- Minimum retention and deletion timeline expectations (evidence of deletion within X hours/days).

I've attached a short list of specific questions (Helix_health_sccs_questions_v1.docx). Can you confirm what you can commit to contractually and what operational controls you can provide as supplementary measures?

We may require a technical call with your infra/security leads after your initial answers.

Thanks,
Andrew
Andrew Bates
Head of Cloud Security, HelixHealth
andrew.bates@helixhealth.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>

Andrew — thanks for the clear list and the doc. Looping in Ben (sales) and our privacy/infra leads so we can get a coordinated response and a short MAP.

Quick clarifying asks from our side before the tech call:
- Do you require EU-only for all processing (including telemetry/monitoring) or only for customer PII/PHI?
- Is HelixHealth willing to accept a documented "break-glass" process for emergency support with JIT approvals and audit notification?
- Expected SLA for deletion evidence (e.g., proof delivered within 48 hours)?

We're preparing a short ops matrix and a proposed SCCs redline to share ahead of the call. Tentative next steps:
1) Redwood provides written answers and attachments (ops matrix, sample deletion manifest).
2) Technical workshop (60m) with Helix infra + Redwood infra + privacy.
3) Contract redline & DocuSign.

Attachments we'll share: redwood-eu-only-ops-matrix.xlsx, SCCs-draft-redline.pdf. When is a good time for the workshop this week?

— Jasmine

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Andrew Bates <andrew.bates@helixhealth.com>, jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, privacy@helixhealth.com
Date: 2028-06-14T16:08:00Z
Subject: Re: EU-only routing confirmation + SCCs questions

Hi Andrew — I reviewed the questions and put together operational commitments we can provide and where we recommend contractual language. Summary below; full ops matrix attached.

1) EU-only processing: For production traffic we will route and process HelixHealth tenant data to EU-designated regions only (we default to eu-west-1 / eu-central-1 depending on proximity). This includes model inference, prefix/KV cache, and any generated embeddings. Non-production telemetry can be routed to other regions, but we can segregate Helix telemetry to EU on request (will call out in SLA).

2) Backups & snapshots: Snapshots are stored in EU by default. For cross-border DR (very rare), we require written customer approval; this is an opt-in and documented.

3) KMS & key control: Customer-managed keys are supported (bring-your-own KMS) with keys provisioned in an EU KMS region. Redwood-managed KMS keys can be restricted to EU only and access is controlled via IAM and RBAC.

4) Employee access: We cannot commit to an absolute prohibition of access by any US-based employee in all scenarios (e.g., legal obligations, emergency support). Instead we offer:
   - Dedicated plan option (customer-dedicated infra) to minimize cross-team access.
   - Break-glass process: JIT approvals, documented justification, time-limited access, and automated audit trail + customer notification.

5) SCCs & supplementary measures: We will sign SCCs and provide the following supplementary measures: EU-only KMS keys, contractual logging commitments, export-control appendix, and operational attestation (quarterly). We'll provide a redline for legal review.

6) Deletion and evidence: We can provide a deletion manifest (CSV) that lists object ids, deletion timestamps, and snapshot purge confirmation. For normal deletion requests we aim to provide evidence within 72 hours; for higher-assurance customers we can commit to 48 hours in contract.

7) Audit & monitoring: We can provide access logs, admin audit trails, and periodic attestation of no-export. We can also run a one-time third-party scan on a Dedicated deployment if Helix requests it.

Next steps:
- I attached the ops matrix (redwood-eu-only-ops-matrix.xlsx) and SCCs redline (SCCs-draft-redline.pdf).
- Please confirm whether you need Dedicated/Private pilot or whether the hosted guarantees suffice.

Happy to jump on the tech call. Suggested times: Thu 2028-06-15 10:00 or 15:00 CET.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Privacy & Compliance, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

From: Andrew Bates <andrew.bates@helixhealth.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, privacy@helixhealth.com
Date: 2028-06-15T09:44:00Z
Subject: Re: EU-only routing confirmation + SCCs questions

Lauren / team — thanks, this is very helpful. A few clarifications before the workshop:

- Helix requires EU-only for all processing of patient data (PHI) including monitoring/telemetry that can be linked to PHI. Non-PHI telemetry can be handled separately.
- For backups: we need contractual assurance that snapshots for PHI will remain in the EU unless Helix explicitly approves cross-border DR (we will only approve in extreme conditions).
- On employee access: the break-glass model is acceptable provided it includes: customer pre-approved emergencies list, 2FA JIT approval with Helix security on the approval flow, and immediate notification + detailed audit bundle within 24 hours.
- Deletion evidence: 48 hours is preferable. If Redwood can commit to 48 hours in contract that will accelerate procurement.
- We may require a Dedicated pilot for PHI workloads (legal + security prefer dedicated infra for initial onboarding).

Please confirm you can include the 48-hour deletion-evidence SLA in the SCCs redline and provide an example deletion manifest during the workshop.

Thanks — will join the Thu 15:00 CET slot unless you hear otherwise.

— Andrew

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Andrew Bates <andrew.bates@helixhealth.com>, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-06-16T14:12:00Z
Subject: Re: EU-only routing confirmation + SCCs questions — infra details and sample artifacts

Andrew — quick infra ops note ahead of the workshop and a couple of sample artifacts attached.

Operational commitments we can demonstrate live in the workshop:
- Routing: Tenant-level routing policy that pins Helix tenant IDs to EU zones. We maintain a per-tenant metadata flag used by the router to enforce region affinity; this is enforced at the edge and validated at our service mesh.
- Backups: Snapshots are tagged with tenant_id and region; scheduled snapshot retention defaults to EU S3 buckets in the designated region. Cross-border DR requires documented customer opt-in.
- KMS: We support customer-managed keys in eu-west-1/eu-central-1. Keys are never exported by Redwood; access is via strict IAM policies.
- Deletion flow: On customer deletion request we: mark objects for deletion, remove primary objects, schedule snapshot purge, and run a manifest generator that produces a CSV with object ids + deletion timestamps + snapshot purge confirmation.
- Proof artifacts: sample deletion-manifest-sample.csv and a network-segmentation-diagram.png attached.

Limitations/notes:
- SaaS telemetry that is strictly operational (non-PHI) may flow to US monitoring stacks unless Helix opts into EU-only telemetry.
- For the 48-hour deletion evidence SLA we can commit on Dedicated customers or hosted customers with the higher SLA add-on. We'll propose language for both cases in the redline.

I'll be on the Thu 2028-06-15 15:00 CET workshop and can demo the manifest generation.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Infrastructure — Redwood Inference
